    President Trump is scheduled to deliver a primetime address on the Iran war on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 9 p.m. ET (6 p.m. PT)
    . You can watch it on major networks (ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, CNN, Fox News), the White House website, or YouTube channels for the White House, PBS NewsHour, and USA TODAY. 
    Where to Watch: 
    • Live Broadcast: ABC, NBC, CBS, FOX, CNN, Fox News, NewsNation
    • Live Stream Online:
      • WhiteHouse.gov/live
      • White House YouTube Channel
      • PBS NewsHour YouTube Channel
      • USA TODAY YouTube Channel
      • C-SPAN
    • Streaming Services: Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV, Sling
    • Apps: FOX LOCAL app 
    The speech is expected to last roughly 20 minutes, providing an update on the conflict in Iran.
